fields.proposed_value: Discovery call with Pampa Agro. Field reps visit about 200 dealers weekly and record visits on paper and in spreadsheets, so orders and promises get lost. The team needs one place for visits, orders and promises, for 38 users, working offline with GPS check-in and connected to Orion ERP. Budget is about USD 70,000 per year. A field demo with two reps was agreed for 11 Nov.
